bootstrap.cells: stratified by tissue (empty tissue = own stratum)

F1.claim: free virtual RNA layer beats M alone
F1.rule: gain(M+vRNA vs M) > 0 and bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0

F2.claim: free virtual P layer beats M alone
F2.rule: gain(M+vP vs M) > 0 and bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0

F3.claim: paired-shuffle controls do not beat M
F3.rule: for each of vRNA_shuf, vP_shuf: bootstrap interval of gain vs M contains 0 or gain < 0

F4.claim: recovered share consistent with development folds
F4.rule: share = gain(M+vY vs M)/gain(M+Y vs M) in [0.15, 0.55] for Y=RNA and Y=P, and F1 and F2 confirmed

F5.rule: protein and gene panels: R(32) >= 0.5 and R(64) >= 0.5 (teacher M+Pval / M+RNA)

F6.rule: gain(M+T vs M) > 0 and bootstrap lower bound > 0

F7.rule: gain(M+P graph vs M) > 0 (direction; interval reported)

F8.claim: F1, F2, F5 reproduce on the CRISPR endpoint
F8.rule: same rules on CRISPR gene effect
